items.title: Sam Dutrey Interview
items.q: I was quite a large man. There was Gene Porter, Gishard, Ransom Nolens, Eugene Ware, Bucket, and then Joe.

ctx.x: See, were you on any of those records that Joe Robichaud made? I forget now.
Well I know he had a small outfit then. I forget that you were all known. Yeah, I know. I was quite a large man. There was Gene Porter, Gishard, Ransom Nolens, Eugene Ware, Bucket, and then Joe.
